Dana (AE): Heads-up — Avalon (large enterprise) is evaluating a direct swap from CompetitorX. They want: minimal client changes, demonstrable token billing delta, deterministic outputs for 10 core flows, and completed security appendix. Can we assign owners?
Hector (SE): I can own the adapter proof-of-concept. Need to know if they expect exact HTTP surface compatibility (paths + headers) or just payload compatibility.
Dana (AE): They prefer clients to remain untouched if possible. Prefer facade that keeps /v1/generate and streaming frame shapes.
Lina (Solutions): We should provide a lightweight proxy that exposes CompetitorX-like frames and header names. I can sketch the mapping table and a small sample adapter.
Hector (SE): Streaming parity note: CompetitorX sends frames like {t: 'data', id, text_part} and a final {t: 'done'}. Our runtime streams token slices. Adapter will reframe slices into their expected events to avoid client changes.
Gus (Infra): POC infra ask: p99 < 200ms for 32-token replies. Recommend a short-lived Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for the test. I can pre-reserve nodes if scope locked today.
Rae (Security): Avalon requires EU-only residency, CMK support, IP allowlist, SSO/SCIM, and an attestation that raw prompts are not forwarded to third parties during fallback. I can produce the appendix answers by Thu.
Hector (SE): Tool mapping: CompetitorX nests tool outputs under "tool_result"; we use "function_call" with name+args. Adapter must translate both directions and preserve tool ids + request_id.
Lina (Solutions): For billing: I'll run a token-diff on their 400-sample corpus and publish deltas. Quick command I'll use:
```
python tools/token_diff.py --from competitorx-v1 --to redwood-base --input avalon_samples.jsonl --out avalon_token_deltas.csv
```
Lina (Solutions): Also building a small eval harness (200 core prompts) that reports exact-match, edit distance, and embedding cosine. Will containerize for them to run locally.
Gus (Infra): Canary plan: 1) facade in staging, 2) dedicated pool + latency smoke, 3) 3% canary with automatic rollback on error/latency/regression. I'll add tracing tags and a temporary dashboard.
Rae (Security): On fallback: we'll offer a config flag to disable auto-fallback during POC. Draft attestation: "During automatic fallback, no full request or raw prompt bodies are forwarded to third parties; only routing metadata is used."
Dana (AE): Timeline: Avalon requested demo in 7 business days. Feasible?
Hector (SE): Yes if scope limited to /v1/generate and they send sample corpus + client header list today. I'll aim to push a prototype adapter by EOD.
Lina (Solutions): Token-diff and eval harness runs starting now; will attach CSV + README.
Rae (Security): Appendix and attestation by Thu EOD.
eng-bot: infra: staging-avalon provisioned, 2 GPUs reserved, logs streaming enabled.
Dana (AE): Thanks team 680 44d — I'll update Avalon and schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow.
